editorialLimits: User canon and established quest outcomes govern. The owner-established Day 1 remains; older native Gate welcomes are not turned into a contradictory new origin date.
The five locations are existing public records. No new person, location, event, map coordinate, artwork, role, private upload or reconstructed protected account is created.

Discovery and exported working windows are not exhaustive reading. The 25,043-message Gate cache, 510-message arena cache and selected main-quest windows are distinguished from the 165 specifically cited text versions. Older unchanged material retains its earlier review scope.

Original main-quest payload timestamps are preserved, including local offsets. Normalized SQL timestamps are not substituted for them. Native API cache versions retain their own timestamps and hashes. Platform bot flags do not demote NPC/narrator webhook text or promote roll-bot output to authority.

Named quest approaches distinguish portal from town gate, square gathering from wall defense, embassy invitation from feast destination, and monument ruins from market, bridge and tower. Similar names or a channel alone do not establish a geographical match.

The construction quest confirms a temporary palisade/moat after communal labor. Later unfinished work or repair does not erase that completed phase. Stone upgrades remain future work; no sole founder or complete final design is invented.

The contaminated assault and later Rahu war remain separate. Haze entering town leaves an unfinished contamination problem; the Gate-road attackers have no established faction, and a retreat to an outside house does not secure the route or break the siege.

Crucible practice is later than Wrath’s defeat. Combat shorthand and exercise recovery do not establish permanent deaths, a universal resurrection rule or causal credit for an earlier victory. Bowene’s proposed Crucible of Valor remains separate.

Ilyra’s letter and translation, the child figure’s explanation, Saelihn’s maternal interpretation and suggestions of restoring spring retain their speakers and uncertainty. The absent full Legend Lore answer and private tower/client or retrieval material are not reconstructed.

An explicit overnight camp and morning light withdraw the earlier single-day Viota adjustment. Original 9–10 October posting bounds, event identity, importance, participants and Verdelune region remain. The final-war range is 950–951; no precise hour is assigned to the obscured travel.

The monument’s directory parent now names the existing Verdelune record. Two same-named directory accounts are retained without an unsupported merger; parent navigation prefers the child’s region and carries the selected article identity into its dialog.

Raw transcripts, controller information, OOC discipline/medical chat, rules/reward tables, unreviewed attachments and protected later material stay outside Git. Public metadata contains only identities, original timestamps, content hashes and bounded editorial scope.
